_comment: Machine-readable output contract for chembl-hit-series-sar-docking (Review Stop 4A finding 1). scripts/report_qc.py::assert_output_contract reads this in the terminal step, BEFORE write_facts(), and fails closed unless every artifact exists at its declared path (relative to /mnt/results), is non-empty, and carries the declared columns/keys/content. '{target}' is substituted with the target symbol (e.g. EGFR). This is the run's expectation and the run cannot rewrite it.

delivery_receipt._comment: Family F04 (final_delivery_and_output_manifest_drift). report_qc.assert_delivery_receipt reads THIS block AFTER staging and fails closed unless every required report/table/figure/provenance/test/manifest path resolves on disk, AND the 'artifacts' above are all named here (inventory == declared contract == receipt). It is a superset of 'artifacts' extended with the figure/provenance/test/manifest categories the contract gate does not cover. Removing or renaming any receipt-named artifact after staging fails the gate. The run cannot rewrite it.
